goal: Prevent duplicate manual outbound P2P connections to the same target
Avoids opening parallel connections when startup options or manual RPC calls race
agreement: Strong support with testing and no open objections
Verified by running unit and functional test suites and checking failure modes (8144225309)
Verified on I2P that concurrent manual RPC commands no longer open duplicate connections (Bicaru20)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a race condition that allows redundant manual outbound connections
Concurrent connection attempts at startup or via RPC can waste network slots and sockets
